name: inspect_packet_capture
title: Inspect packet capture
description: Project caller-supplied captured inspect_packet_capture Evidence or a previously decoded packet result. The native boundary is read-only and performs no TShark invocation, path access, live capture, or device communication. Captured bytes may accompany a result for artifact identity verification; raw bytes alone cannot establish selected TShark fields.

result.description: Evidence normalized_result containing artifact identity, exact selection, packet fields, output window, tool identity, diagnostics, limits, and provenance
